source_refs.note: Unnumbered topic Biometric Verification under 9.2 as printed (PDF 127, printed 123).

blocks.text: Biometric verification uses physical features such as fingerprints, face scans, or voice patterns to verify identity. Biometrics add strong layers of protection to keep accounts and personal data safe.

blocks.title: Class Activity
blocks.text: Students simulate logging into an account with a second step (code from teacher) to understand how 2FA works.
